title: StreamEvent
description: Contract 7: real-time graph change notification. Events are emitted at the mutation point (ingestion/deletion) and delivered to subscribers through the in-process bus; the HTTP server exposes them as a live SSE feed and the MCP server replays recent events. A dry run publishes nothing.

protocol.description: The protocol version identifier. Must be 'graphrag/1.0'.

event_id.description: Unique, monotonically increasing event id assigned by the bus.

event_type.description: The kind of mutation this event describes.

entity_id.description: Vertex id the event refers to, when the mutation is vertex-scoped.

entity_type.description: Vertex type the event refers to, e.g. 'Paper'.

payload.description: Measured details of the mutation (counts from the ingestion report), never synthesized.

StreamEventType.description: Graph mutation event types. entity_*/edge_* map 1:1 onto a measured mutation; ingestion_completed always closes an ingest/update/delete call.
